description: This file defines a React component for a group header UI element in the Notesnook project, including menu interactions for grouping, sorting, and view modes.

classes.name: GroupHeader
classes.description: React component for displaying and interacting with a group header, including menu options for sorting and view modes.

classes.name: IconButton
classes.description: A button component with an icon, used within the GroupHeader for toggling view modes and sorting.

methods.name: showSortMenu
methods.description: Displays a menu for sorting options based on grouping key.

methods.name: changeGroupOptions
methods.description: Updates group options in the database and search store based on user selection.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps menu items to include click handlers and checked state.
